title: Clinical Trial Decision Lab: a reproducible benchmark of AI decision models for clinical-trial evidence work
description:
A reproducible benchmark of AI decision models, general-purpose LLMs and trained classifiers for clinical-trial evidence work. The screening study predicts whether a systematic review included or excluded a paper from the review title and the paper's title and abstract. The repository also holds a synthetic benchmark for triage of enrollment-eligibility and informed-consent issues. Research only; not validated by clinical experts.

Report: https://smartmobilehouse.com/research/clinical-trial-decision-lab/

Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/smartmobilehouse/clinical-trial-decision-lab-screening
